v.description: Input array. Can be N-dimensional but is flattened to 1D.
constraints: Input v and output Array must have same dtype

k.description: optional, default=0. Diagonal offset. Positive values place the diagonal above the main diagonal, negative values place it below the main diagonal.

output.description: A 2D array with the input elements placed along the diagonal with the specified offset (k). The remaining entries are filled with zeros.
